body.p: This Order Form is entered into as of {{effective}} between {{fontara_entity}} ("Vendor") and **{{customer}}**, {{customer_entity}} with its principal place of business at {{customer_address}}, {{customer_city}}, {{customer_region}} {{customer_postal}} ("Customer"), under the Master Services Agreement between them dated {{msa_date}} (the "Agreement").
Quote **{{quote}}**, valid until {{quote_valid}}. Customer orders the following for the Fontara platform, {{plan}} plan; amounts are annual and in the currency of this Order Form.

then.p: The Enterprise plan includes a named customer success manager, single sign-on and a 99.9% monthly uptime commitment.

body.p: Vendor shall provide the products and services listed in this Order Form, in the quantities and at the unit prices stated for each. The product documentation describes their features and is incorporated by reference. Vendor may rename a product without Customer's consent if its functionality is unchanged.
The subscription term begins on {{effective}} and continues for an Initial Term of {{initial_term}}, expiring on {{expiration}}.

then.p: It renews automatically for successive 1-year terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least 60 days before the end of the then-current term.
This Order Form does not renew. Any continuation after it ends requires a new written agreement signed by both parties.
It is governed by the Agreement and ends on {{expiration}} or, if earlier, when the Agreement ends. It does not renew separately.

The fees under this Order Form total {{currency}}{{contract_value}}, with an annual value of {{currency}}{{annual_value}}. Fees are Vendor's list prices less the discounts stated in this Order Form, and are fixed for the Initial Term. A volume discount in this Order Form applies while Customer's use stays at or above its threshold.

The fees under this Order Form total {{currency}}{{contract_value}}, with an annual value of {{currency}}{{annual_value}}. The discounts in this Order Form apply to the Initial Term only and do not carry forward to any renewal, and a volume discount applies only if Customer's use stays at or above its threshold for the whole term.

The fees under this Order Form total {{currency}}{{contract_value}}, with an annual value of {{currency}}{{annual_value}}. Fees are fixed for the subscription term and, if the subscription renews, the discounts in this Order Form carry forward to each renewal term. If Vendor offers better pricing for the same products to a comparable customer, it shall offer the same pricing to Customer.

Vendor shall invoice the fees annually in advance, and each invoice is payable {{payment_terms}} from the invoice date. Customer may dispute an invoice in good faith by written notice within 30 days of receipt, and must pay the undisputed portion when due; no late interest accrues on an amount disputed in good faith. Undisputed amounts more than 30 days overdue accrue interest at 1% per month.

Vendor shall invoice the fees for the full subscription term in advance, and each invoice is payable {{payment_terms}} from its date. Past-due amounts accrue interest at 1.5% per month, and the undisputed part of an invoice is due even while a dispute is pending. Vendor may suspend the Services for any amount more than 15 days overdue without further notice, and Customer shall pay Vendor's costs of collection, including attorneys' fees.

Vendor shall invoice the fees monthly, and each invoice is payable {{payment_terms}} from its date. Undisputed past-due amounts accrue interest at 1% per month, and amounts Customer disputes in good faith accrue no interest while the dispute is resolved. Vendor may not suspend the Services without 30 days' written notice, and shall correct any billing error within 30 days of Customer's notice of it.

body.p: Customer billing contact email: [[email:Customer:Billing contact email]]  Customer purchase order number (optional): [[text?:Customer:PO number]]  Customer VAT or tax ID (if any): [[text?:Customer:Tax ID]]

then.p: Fees exclude sales, use and similar taxes, which Customer pays unless it gives Vendor a valid exemption certificate.
Fees exclude VAT, which Customer pays at the applicable rate or accounts for under the reverse charge where it applies.
Fees exclude VAT, which Customer pays at the applicable rate or accounts for under the reverse charge where it applies.

body.p: Customer's use is limited to the quantities in this Order Form, and Vendor shall notify Customer when its use reaches 80% of a limit. Use above a limit is billed at {{overage_rate}}, prorated to the end of the current term. If Customer exceeds a limit in 3 consecutive months, the parties shall sign an order for the higher quantity.

Only the authorized users Customer names, who must be its employees, may use the Services. Customer may extend use to an affiliate by written notice and an amendment to this Order Form. User credentials may not be shared or transferred, and Customer is responsible for keeping them secure and for promptly removing access for anyone who leaves.
Customer system administrator: [[text:Customer:Administrator name]]  Administrator email: [[email:Customer:Administrator email]]

then.p: Fees for each renewal term may increase over the fees for the preceding term by no more than {{price_cap}}. Vendor must give written notice of any increase at least 60 days before the last day for notice of non-renewal; without that notice, fees for the renewal term are unchanged.

Each renewal term is invoiced at Vendor's then-current list price for the subscribed products. Vendor posts price changes on its website and may notify Customer by email, and Customer's failure to give notice of non-renewal is acceptance of the renewal price.

Fees for each renewal term may increase by no more than the lesser of {{price_cap}} and the change in the US Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers over the preceding 12 months, and not at all at the first renewal. Vendor must give written notice of any increase at least 120 days before the end of the current term.

body.p: Products and quantities added during the subscription term are co-terminous with it: their fees are prorated from their start date to the end of the current term, at the unit prices in this Order Form, and if the subscription renews they renew with it, at the same unit prices as the base products.

Vendor measures Customer's use of each subscribed product quarterly. If average use in a year exceeds the purchased quantity, Vendor invoices the excess at the unit prices in this Order Form, prorated from the quarter in which it began, and the renewal quantity equals the higher of the purchased quantity and the average use in the last quarter. At renewal Customer may reduce quantities by up to 10%.

Each renewal term is governed by the Agreement and this Order Form as in effect at the end of the preceding term. Vendor may propose changes to the terms for a renewal by written notice at least 90 days before the last day for notice of non-renewal, and the changes apply only if Customer agrees to them in writing.
